title: MM6 Cave Dragon
description: Original MM6 cave dragon A: upright wingless long-necked dragon with a large heavy lower body, short bent forearms, powerful hind legs, a long tail resting on the ground and curling forward around the feet, very fine dark teal/green mottled scales, rusty orange segmented throat/belly/underside, large orange ear fins with green rims, ivory pale green horns and back/tail spikes, ivory claws, tiny bright orange-yellow eyes and muted mauve mouth. Keep exact native slender long neck, small head, bent arms, stocky thighs and original dragon head silhouette. No wings, armor, added accessories, cartoon baby-dragon features or modern redesign.
regions: Teal green scaly skin, rusty orange throat/belly/ear membranes, ivory horn/spine/claw material and mouth/eyes. Preserve all native palette variants by selective deterministic recoloring of one base generation.
